settings.name: Priority Source
settings.description: Auto-select this format for playback. MP4 (H.264): widest hardware decode support, lower CPU usage, best for older devices. WebM (AV1): ~30% smaller files at same quality, sharper at low bitrates, requires newer hardware for smooth decode.

settings.name: Playlist Content Sorting
settings.description: Controls the order of talks within playlists. Oldest first shows talks in chronological order. Newest first shows the most recent talks first.
